objectRules.IDENTITY_MATCH: objectBase64 required; strictly decoded (duplicate-free, no NaN, depth <= 16), its apiVersion, kind, metadata.namespace and metadata.name equal the armed template and its metadata.uid and metadata.resourceVersion equal the gate's observation
objectRules.IDENTITY_IF_PRESENT: objectBase64 optional; when present, the IDENTITY_MATCH rule applies

rules: An exact httpStatus row takes precedence over a status-class row; any status without a row (1xx, 3xx, other 2xx) has no agreement.
Only an OK ACTION_OUTCOME is usable; a refused or missing one is a missing outcome.
Any disagreement, a missing ACTION_OUTCOME or a missing RESOURCE_RESULT is sticky failure: the broker holds the generation HELD and never advances the I02 transcript past the action.
admittedBeforeInvalidation does not change the mapped outcome; an execution with such an action never ends COMPLETED, and its resources stay owned for exact-UID cleanup.

Object content beyond identity, UID and resourceVersion is not verified. resultDigest is the gate's digest of the exact relayed response body, kept for reconciliation; RESOURCE_RESULT carries bounded observed-object data (I02 unchanged).
